taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-05 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1320.7 | 0.60 | 0.60
2 | 719.2 | 0.46 | 1.06
3 | 872.7 | 0.61 | 1.67
4 | 340.7 | 0.38 | 2.05
5 | 4088.9 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as QQH-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-05
Curve type: QQH
Aquifer depth: 1.67 m – 2.05 m
Recommendation: Target the low-resistivity zone (Layer 4, 340.7 Ω·m) between 1.67 m and 2.05 m as the probable water-bearing horizon; given its shallow depth and thin extent (~0.38 m), ensure proper casing/grouting of the overlying layers to prevent surface contamination and confirm yield with a short test pump before full development.
